docs.title: ಮಂತ್ರ 3.2.1
docs.text:
ಸ ವೇದೈತತ್ಪರಮಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಧಾಮ ಯತ್ರ ವಿಶ್ವಂ ನಿಹಿತಂ ಭಾತಿ ಶುಭ್ರಮ್ । ಉಪಾಸತೇ ಪುರುಷಂ ಯೇ ಹ್ಯಕಾಮಾಸ್ತೇ ಶುಕ್ರಮೇತದತಿವರ್ತಂತಿ ಧೀರಾಃ ॥ ೧ ॥ He knows that supreme Brahman, the luminous abode in which the entire universe rests and shines. Those wise ones who, free from desires, meditate upon that Purusha, transcend this seed of birth (saṁsāra).

ಸಃ ವೇದ ಏತತ್ ಪರಮಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಧಾಮ

He knows this supreme Brahman, the abode.

  • ಸಃ → he
  • ವೇದ → knows
  • ಏತತ್ → this
  • ಪರಮಂ → supreme
  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ → Brahman
  • ಧಾಮ → abode, luminous reality

ಯತ್ರ ವಿಶ್ವಂ ನಿಹಿತಂ ಭಾತಿ ಶುಭ್ರಂ

Where the whole universe rests and shines in purity.

  • ಯತ್ರ → wherein
  • ವಿಶ್ವಂ → universe
  • ನಿಹಿತಂ → lodged, established
  • ಭಾತಿ → shines
  • ಶುಭ್ರಂ → pure, luminous

ಉಪಾಸತೇ ಪುರುಷಂ ಯೇ ಹಿ ಅಕಾಮಾಃ

Those who are desireless meditate upon the Purusha.

  • ಉಪಾಸತೇ → meditate upon
  • ಪುರುಷಂ → Purusha, Supreme Being
  • ಯೇ → who
  • ಹಿ → indeed
  • ಅಕಾಮಾಃ → free from desires

ತೇ ಶುಕ್ರಮ್ ಏತತ್ ಅತಿವರ್ತಂತಿ ಧೀರಾಃ

Those wise ones transcend this seed/source of birth.

  • ತೇ → they
  • ಶುಕ್ರಮ್ → seed, source of generation
  • ಏತತ್ → this
  • ಅತಿವರ್ತಂತಿ → transcend
  • ಧೀರಾಃ → wise ones

docs.title: ಭಾಷ್ಯ
docs.text:
ಯಸ್ಮಾತ್ ಸ ವೇದ ಜಾನಾತಿ ಏತತ್ ಯಥೋಕ್ತಲಕ್ಷಣಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಪರಮಂ ಪ್ರಕೃಷ್ಟಂ ಧಾಮ ಸರ್ವಕಾಮಾನಾಮಾಶ್ರಯಮಾಸ್ಪದಮ್, ಯತ್ರ ಯಸ್ಮಿನ್ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣಿ ಧಾಮ್ನಿ ವಿಶ್ವಂ ಸಮಸ್ತಂ ಜಗತ್ ನಿಹಿತಮ್ ಅರ್ಪಿತಮ್, ಯಚ್ಚ ಸ್ವೇನ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಾ ಭಾತಿ ಶುಭ್ರಂ ಶುದ್ಧಮ್, ತಮಪ್ಯೇವಂವಿಧಮಾತ್ಮಜ್ಞಂ ಪುರುಷಂ ಯೇ ಹಿ ಅಕಾಮಾಃ ವಿಭೂತಿತೃಷ್ಣಾವರ್ಜಿತಾ ಮುಮುಕ್ಷವಃ ಸಂತಃ ಉಪಾಸತೇ ಪರಮಿವ ದೇವಮ್, ತೇ ಶುಕ್ರಂ ನೃಬೀಜಂ ಯದೇತತ್ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಂ ಶರೀರೋಪಾದಾನಕಾರಣಮ್ ಅತಿವರ್ತಂತಿ ಅತಿಗಚ್ಛಂತಿ ಧೀರಾಃ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮಂತಃ, ನ ಪುನರ್ಯೋನಿಂ ಪ್ರಸರ್ಪಂತಿ । ‘ನ ಪುನಃ ಕ್ವ ರತಿಂ ಕರೋತಿ’ ಇತಿ ಶ್ರುತೇಃ । ಅತಸ್ತಂ ಪೂಜಯೇದಿತ್ಯಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಃ ॥ Because he knows this Brahman characterized as previously described—the supreme Reality, the support and abode of all desires, in which the entire universe is established and offered, and which shines by its own light as pure—that knower of the Self, being of such nature, is meditated upon by seekers of liberation who are free from craving for powers and enjoyments, as though He were the Supreme Lord Himself. Those wise ones transcend this seed of human birth, namely the well-known cause of embodiment. They do not again enter the womb. As the scripture says: > "He does not again delight in birth." Therefore, the intention is that such a knower should indeed be worshipped.

ಯಸ್ಮಾತ್ ಸಃ ವೇದ ಜಾನಾತಿ ಏತತ್ ಯಥೋಕ್ತಲಕ್ಷಣಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ

Because he knows this Brahman characterized as previously described.

  • ಯಸ್ಮಾತ್ → because
  • ಸಃ → he
  • ವೇದ → knows
  • ಜಾನಾತಿ → understands
  • ಏತತ್ → this
  • ಯಥೋಕ್ತಲಕ್ಷಣಂ → having the characteristics already described
  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ → Brahman

ಪರಮಂ ಪ್ರಕೃಷ್ಟಂ ಧಾಮ ಸರ್ವಕಾಮಾನಾಂ ಆಶ್ರಯಂ ಆಸ್ಪದಂ

The supreme abode and support of all desires.

  • ಪರಮಂ → supreme
  • ಪ್ರಕೃಷ್ಟಂ → highest
  • ಧಾಮ → abode
  • ಸರ್ವಕಾಮಾನಾಂ → of all desires
  • ಆಶ್ರಯಂ → support
  • ಆಸ್ಪದಂ → resting place

ಯತ್ರ ಯಸ್ಮಿನ್ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣಿ ಧಾಮ್ನಿ ವಿಶ್ವಂ ಸಮಸ್ತಂ ಜಗತ್ ನಿಹಿತಂ ಅರ್ಪಿತಂ

In which Brahman the entire universe is established and offered.

  • ಯತ್ರ → wherein
  • ಯಸ್ಮಿನ್ → in which
  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಣಿ → in Brahman
  • ಧಾಮ್ನಿ → in the luminous abode
  • ವಿಶ್ವಂ → universe
  • ಸಮಸ್ತಂ → entire
  • ಜಗತ್ → world
  • ನಿಹಿತಂ → placed
  • ಅರ್ಪಿತಂ → offered/resting

ಯತ್ ಚ ಸ್ವೇನ ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಾ ಭಾತಿ ಶುಭ್ರಂ ಶುದ್ಧಂ

And which shines by its own light as pure.

  • ಯತ್ → which
  • ಚ → and
  • ಸ್ವೇನ → by its own
  • ಜ್ಯೋತಿಷಾ → light
  • ಭಾತಿ → shines
  • ಶುಭ್ರಂ → luminous/pure
  • ಶುದ್ಧಂ → pure

ತಂ ಅಪಿ ಏವಂವಿಧಂ ಆತ್ಮಜ್ಞಂ ಪುರುಷಂ ಯೇ ಹಿ ಅಕಾಮಾಃ ವಿಭೂತಿತೃಷ್ಣಾ ವರ್ಜಿತಾಃ ಮುಮುಕ್ಷವಃ ಸಂತಃ ಉಪಾಸತೇ

That knower of the Self is meditated upon by desireless seekers of liberation free from craving for powers.

  • ತಂ → that
  • ಅಪಿ → indeed
  • ಏವಂವಿಧಂ → of such nature
  • ಆತ್ಮಜ್ಞಂ → knower of Self
  • ಪುರುಷಂ → person
  • ಯೇ → who
  • ಹಿ → indeed
  • ಅಕಾಮಾಃ → desireless
  • ವಿಭೂತಿ → powers/glories
  • ತೃಷ್ಣಾ → craving
  • ವರ್ಜಿತಾಃ → free from
  • ಮುಮುಕ್ಷವಃ → seekers of liberation
  • ಸಂತಃ → being
  • ಉಪಾಸತೇ → meditate upon/worship

ಪರಂ ಇವ ದೇವಂ

As though He were the Supreme Lord.

  • ಪರಂ → supreme
  • ಇವ → as though
  • ದೇವಂ → divine Lord

ತೇ ಶುಕ್ರಂ ನೃಬೀಜಂ ಯತ್ ಏತತ್ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಂ ಶರೀರೋಪಾದಾನಕಾರಣಂ ಅತಿವರ್ತಂತಿ ಅತಿಗಚ್ಛಂತಿ ಧೀರಾಃ

Those wise ones transcend the seed of human birth, the cause of embodiment.

  • ತೇ → they
  • ಶುಕ್ರಂ → seed
  • ನೃಬೀಜಂ → human seed
  • ಯತ್ → which
  • ಏತತ್ → this
  • ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಂ → well-known
  • ಶರೀರೋಪಾದಾನಕಾರಣಂ → cause of bodily embodiment
  • ಅತಿವರ್ತಂತಿ → transcend
  • ಅತಿಗಚ್ಛಂತಿ → go beyond
  • ಧೀರಾಃ → wise ones

ನ ಪುನಃ ಯೋನಿಂ ಪ್ರಸರ್ಪಂತಿ

They do not again enter the womb.

  • ನ → not
  • ಪುನಃ → again
  • ಯೋನಿಂ → womb/birth
  • ಪ್ರಸರ್ಪಂತಿ → enter/proceed into

ನ ಪುನಃ ಕ್ವ ರತಿಂ ಕರೋತಿ ಇತಿ ಶ್ರುತೇಃ

As scripture says: “He does not again delight in birth.”

  • ನ → not
  • ಪುನಃ → again
  • ಕ್ವ → anywhere
  • ರತಿಂ → attachment/delight/like
  • ಕರೋತಿ → makes
  • ಇತಿ → thus
  • ಶ್ರುತೇಃ → from scripture

ಅತಃ ತಂ ಪೂಜಯೇತ್ ಇತಿ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಃ

Therefore the intention is that such a knower should be worshipped.

  • ಅತಃ → therefore
  • ತಂ → him
  • ಪೂಜಯೇತ್ → should worship
  • ಇತಿ → thus
  • ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯಃ → intention

docs.title: Avatārikā Bhāṣya
docs.text:
ಮಂತ್ರೋಕ್ತಸ್ಯಾರ್ಥಸ್ಯ ವಿಸ್ತರಾನುವಾದೀದಂ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಮಾರಭ್ಯತೇ । ಋಷಿಪ್ರಶ್ನಪ್ರತಿವಾಚನಾಖ್ಯಾಯಿಕಾ ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾಸ್ತುತಯೇ । ಏವಂ ಸಂವತ್ಸರಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯಸಂವಾಸಾದಿತಪೋಯುಕ್ತೈರ್ಗ್ರಾಹ್ಯಾ, ಪಿಪ್ಪಲಾದವತ್ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞಕಲ್ಪೈರಾಚಾರ್ಯೈಃ ವಕ್ತವ್ಯಾ ಚ, ನ ಯೇನ ಕೇನಚಿದಿತಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾಂ ಸ್ತೌತಿ । ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯಾದಿಸಾಧನಸೂಚನಾಚ್ಚ ತತ್ಕರ್ತವ್ಯತಾ ಸ್ಯಾತ್ — This Brāhmaṇa section is now commenced as a detailed exposition of the meaning that was briefly stated in the mantra. The narrative in the form of the sages asking questions and receiving answers is intended for the glorification of this knowledge (Brahma-vidyā). The purpose is to praise the knowledge by showing that it is fit to be received only by those who have undergone austerities such as living in brahmacarya for a year, residing with the teacher, and observing other disciplines. Likewise, it is to be taught only by teachers who, like Pippalāda, are comparable to omniscient persons; it is not something that may be taught by just anyone. Thus the Upaniṣad extols the greatness of this knowledge. Furthermore, by indicating disciplines such as brahmacarya and the like, the text also establishes that these are duties to be undertaken by seekers of knowledge.

ಮಂತ್ರೋಕ್ತಸ್ಯಾರ್ಥಸ್ಯ ವಿಸ್ತರಾನುವಾದೀ ಇದಂ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಮಾರಭ್ಯತೇ

This Brāhmaṇa portion is begun as a detailed explanation of the meaning expressed in the mantra.

  • ಮಂತ್ರೋಕ್ತಸ್ಯ → stated in the mantra
  • ಅರ್ಥಸ್ಯ → of the meaning
  • ವಿಸ್ತರ → detailed
  • ಅನುವಾದೀ → explanatory restatement
  • ಇದಂ → this
  • ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಂ → Brāhmaṇa section
  • ಆರಭ್ಯತೇ → is commenced

(Mundaka is mantra and Prasna is brahmana )

ಋಷಿಪ್ರಶ್ನಪ್ರತಿವಾಚನಾಖ್ಯಾಯಿಕಾ ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾಸ್ತುತಯೇ

The narrative consisting of the sages' questions and answers is for the praise of the knowledge.

  • ಋಷಿ → sage
  • ಪ್ರಶ್ನ → question
  • ಪ್ರತಿವಾಚನ → answer
  • ಆಖ್ಯಾಯಿಕಾ → narrative account
  • ತು → indeed
  • ವಿದ್ಯಾ → knowledge
  • ಸ್ತುತಯೇ → for praise

ಏವಂ ಸಂವತ್ಸರಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯಸಂವಾಸಾದಿತಪೋಯುಕ್ತೈರ್ಗ್ರಾಹ್ಯಾ

Thus this knowledge is to be received by those endowed with austerities such as living for a year in brahmacarya and residing with the teacher.

  • ಏವಂ → thus
  • ಸಂವತ್ಸರ → one year
  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯ → celibate discipline
  • ಸಂವಾಸ → residence with the teacher (gurukula)
  • ಆದಿ → and other
  • ತಪಃ → austerities
  • ಯುಕ್ತೈಃ → endowed with
  • ಗ್ರಾಹ್ಯಾ → fit to be received

ಪಿಪ್ಪಲಾದವತ್ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞಕಲ್ಪೈರಾಚಾರ್ಯೈಃ ವಕ್ತವ್ಯಾ ಚ

And it is to be taught by teachers who, like Pippalāda, are comparable to omniscient persons.

  • ಪಿಪ್ಪಲಾದವತ್ → like Pippalāda
  • ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞಕಲ್ಪೈಃ → comparable to omniscient beings (kalpa = like)
  • ಆಚಾರ್ಯೈಃ → by teachers
  • ವಕ್ತವ್ಯಾ → should be taught
  • ಚ → and

ನ ಯೇನ ಕೇನಚಿದಿತಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾಂ ಸ್ತೌತಿ

By implying that it should not be taught by just anyone, the text praises the knowledge.

  • ನ → not
  • ಯೇನ ಕೇನಚಿತ್ → by any random person
  • ಇತಿ → thus
  • ವಿದ್ಯಾಂ → the knowledge
  • ಸ್ತೌತಿ → praises

ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯಾದಿಸಾಧನಸೂಚನಾಚ್ಚ ತತ್ಕರ್ತವ್ಯತಾ ಸ್ಯಾತ್

And by indicating disciplines such as brahmacarya, it establishes that these are to be practiced.

  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯಾದಿ → brahmacarya and similar disciplines
  • ಸಾಧನ → means/spiritual disciplines
  • ಸೂಚನಾತ್ → by indicating
  • ಚ → and
  • ತತ್ → those
  • ಕರ್ತವ್ಯತಾ → obligatoriness, duty
  • ಸ್ಯಾತ್ → is established

docs.title: ಮಂತ್ರ 1.1
docs.text:
ಸುಕೇಶಾ ಚ ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಃ ಶೈಬ್ಯಶ್ಚ ಸತ್ಯಕಾಮಃ ಸೌರ್ಯಾಯಣೀ ಚ ಗಾರ್ಗ್ಯಃ ಕೌಸಲ್ಯಶ್ಚಾಶ್ವಲಾಯನೋ ಭಾರ್ಗವೋ ವೈದರ್ಭಿಃ ಕಬಂಧೀ ಕಾತ್ಯಾಯನಸ್ತೇ ಹೈತೇ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಪರಾ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿಷ್ಠಾಃ ಪರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾನ್ವೇಷಮಾಣಾ ಏಷ ಹ ವೈ ತತ್ಸರ್ವಂ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯತೀತಿ ತೇ ಹ ಸಮಿತ್ಪಾಣಯೋ ಭಗವಂತಂ ಪಿಪ್ಪಲಾದಮುಪಸನ್ನಾಃ ॥ ೧ ॥ Sukeśa, the son of Bharadvāja; Satyakāma, the son of Śibi; Gārgya of the lineage of Sūryāyaṇa; Kauśalya, the son of Aśvala; Bhārgava of Vidarbha; and Kabandhi, the son of Kātyāyana—these seekers were devoted to Brahman, established in Brahman, and desirous of knowing the Supreme Brahman. Thinking, “Surely this revered teacher will explain all this to us,” they approached the venerable Pippalāda, carrying sacrificial fuel in their hands.

ಸುಕೇಶಾ ಚ ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಃ

And Sukeśa, the son of Bharadvāja.

  • ಸುಕೇಶಃ → Sukeśa
  • ಚ → and
  • ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಃ → descendant/son of Bharadvāja

ಶೈಬ್ಯಃ ಚ ಸತ್ಯಕಾಮಃ

And Satyakāma, the descendant of Śibi.

  • ಶೈಬ್ಯಃ → descendant of Śibi
  • ಸತ್ಯಕಾಮಃ → Satyakāma

ಸೌರ್ಯಾಯಣೀ ಚ ಗಾರ್ಗ್ಯಃ

And Gārgya of the Sūryāyaṇa lineage.

  • ಸೌರ್ಯಾಯಣೀ → belonging to Sūryāyaṇa lineage
  • ಗಾರ್ಗ್ಯಃ → Gārgya

ಕೌಸಲ್ಯಃ ಚ ಆಶ್ವಲಾಯನಃ

And Kauśalya, son of Aśvala.

  • ಕೌಸಲ್ಯಃ → Kauśalya
  • ಆಶ್ವಲಾಯನಃ → descendant of Aśvala

ಭಾರ್ಗವಃ ವೈದರ್ಭಿಃ

Bhārgava of Vidarbha.

  • ಭಾರ್ಗವಃ → descendant of Bhṛgu
  • ವೈದರ್ಭಿಃ → from Vidarbha

ಕಬಂಧೀ ಕಾತ್ಯಾಯನಃ

Kabandhi, son of Kātyāyana.

  • ಕಬಂಧೀ → Kabandhi
  • ಕಾತ್ಯಾಯನಃ → descendant of Kātyāyana

ತೇ ಹ ಏತೇ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಪರಾಃ

These indeed were devoted to Brahman.

  • ತೇ → they
  • ಹ → indeed
  • ಏತೇ → these
  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಪರಾಃ → having Brahman as their supreme goal

ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿಷ್ಠಾಃ

Established in Brahman.

  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿಷ್ಠಾಃ → steadfast in contemplation of Brahman

In this context, Śaṅkara generally takes this as being devoted to scriptural pursuit and contemplation leading toward Brahma-jñāna.

ಪರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಅನ್ವೇಷಮಾಣಾಃ

Seeking the Supreme Brahman.

  • ಪರಂ → supreme
  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ → Brahman
  • ಅನ್ವೇಷಮಾಣಾಃ → searching for, seeking

ಏಷಃ ಹ ವೈ ತತ್ ಸರ್ವಂ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯತಿ ಇತಿ

Thinking, “Surely he will explain all that.”

  • ಏಷಃ → this teacher
  • ಹ ವೈ → indeed
  • ತತ್ ಸರ್ವಂ → all that (Brahman-related knowledge)
  • ವಕ್ಷ್ಯತಿ → will explain
  • ಇತಿ → thus

ತೇ ಹ ಸಮಿತ್ಪಾಣಯಃ

They approached carrying sacrificial fuel in their hands.

  • ತೇ → they
  • ಹ → indeed
  • ಸಮಿತ್ → sacrificial fuel sticks
  • ಪಾಣಯಃ → in their hands

Samit-pāṇi is symbolic: humility readiness for discipleship willingness to serve the teacher

ಭಗವಂತಂ ಪಿಪ್ಪಲಾದಂ ಉಪಸನ್ನಾಃ

They approached the revered Pippalāda.

  • ಭಗವಂತಂ → venerable, revered one
  • ಪಿಪ್ಪಲಾದಂ → Pippalāda
  • ಉಪಸನ್ನಾಃ → approached

docs.title: ಭಾಷ್ಯ 1.1
docs.text:
ಸುಕೇಶಾ ಚ ನಾಮತಃ, ಭರದ್ವಾಜಸ್ಯಾಪತ್ಯಂ ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಃ । ಶೈಬ್ಯಶ್ಚ ಶಿಬೇರಪತ್ಯಂ ಶೈಬ್ಯಃ, ಸತ್ಯಕಾಮೋ ನಾಮತಃ । ಸೌರ್ಯಾಯಣೀ ಸೂರ್ಯಸ್ಯಾಪತ್ಯಂ ಸೌರ್ಯಃ, ತಸ್ಯಾಪತ್ಯಂ ಸೌರ್ಯಾಯಣಿಃ ; ಛಾಂದಸಂ ಸೌರ್ಯಾಯಣೀತಿ ; ಗಾರ್ಗ್ಯಃ ಗರ್ಗಗೋತ್ರೋತ್ಪನ್ನಃ । ಕೌಸಲ್ಯಶ್ಚ ನಾಮತಃ, ಅಶ್ವಲಸ್ಯಾಪತ್ಯಮಾಶ್ವಲಾಯನಃ । ಭಾರ್ಗವಃ ಭೃಗೋರ್ಗೋತ್ರಾಪತ್ಯಂ ಭಾರ್ಗವಃ, ವೈದರ್ಭಿಃ ವಿದರ್ಭೇಷು ಭವಃ । ಕಬಂಧೀ ನಾಮತಃ, ಕತ್ಯಸ್ಯಾಪತ್ಯಂ ಕಾತ್ಯಾಯನಃ ; ವಿದ್ಯಮಾನಃ ಪ್ರಪಿತಾಮಹೋ ಯಸ್ಯ ಸಃ ; ಯುವಪ್ರತ್ಯಯಃ । ತೇ ಹ ಏತೇ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಪರಾಃ ಅಪರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಪರತ್ವೇನ ಗತಾಃ, ತದನುಷ್ಠಾನನಿಷ್ಠಾಶ್ಚ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿಷ್ಠಾಃ, ಪರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಅನ್ವೇಷಮಾಣಾಃ ಕಿಂ ತತ್ ಯನ್ನಿತ್ಯಂ ವಿಜ್ಞೇಯಮಿತಿ ತತ್ಪ್ರಾಪ್ತ್ಯರ್ಥಂ ಯಥಾಕಾಮಂ ಯತಿಷ್ಯಾಮ ಇತ್ಯೇವಂ ತದನ್ವೇಷಣಂ ಕುರ್ವಂತಃ, ತದಧಿಗಮಾಯ ಏಷ ಹ ವೈ ತತ್ಸರ್ವಂ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯತೀತಿ ಆಚಾರ್ಯಮುಪಜಗ್ಮುಃ । ಕಥಮ್ ? ತೇ ಹ ಸಮಿತ್ಪಾಣಯಃ ಸಮಿದ್ಭಾರಗೃಹೀತಹಸ್ತಾಃ ಸಂತಃ, ಭಗವಂತಂ ಪೂಜಾವಂತಂ ಪಿಪ್ಪಲಾದಮಾಚಾರ್ಯಮ್ ಉಪಸನ್ನಾಃ ಉಪಜಗ್ಮುಃ ॥ Sukeśa is the personal name; being the son of Bharadvāja, he is called Bhāradvāja. Likewise, Śaibya means a descendant of Śibi, while Satyakāma is his personal name. Sauryāyaṇi means a descendant of Sūrya; "Sauryāyaṇi" is a Vedic form of expression. Gārgya means one born in the lineage of Garga. Kauśalya is the personal name, and Āśvalāyana means a descendant of Aśvala. Bhārgava means one descended from the lineage of Bhṛgu, and Vaidarbhi means one belonging to the region of Vidarbha. Kabandhi is the personal name, and Kātyāyana means a descendant of Katya; the suffix indicates that the ancestor (Katya) is still remembered in the lineage. These indeed were devoted to Brahman, taking the lower Brahman as their supreme goal and being steadfast in its contemplation and worship; hence they are called Brahmaniṣṭhas. At the same time, they were seekers of the Supreme Brahman, wondering, "What is that eternal Reality which ought to be known?" Desiring to attain That, and resolving, "We shall strive in every way to realize It," they engaged in the search for the Supreme Brahman. Thinking, "Surely this teacher will explain all that to us," they approached him. How did they approach? Carrying bundles of sacrificial fuel in their hands, they approached the revered and venerable teacher Pippalāda.

ಸುಕೇಶಾ ಚ ನಾಮತಃ

"Sukeśa" is the personal name.

  • ಸುಕೇಶಾ → Sukeśa
  • ನಾಮತಃ → by name

ಭರದ್ವಾಜಸ್ಯ ಅಪತ್ಯಂ ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಃ

Being the son (descendant) of Bharadvāja, he is called Bhāradvāja.

  • ಭರದ್ವಾಜಸ್ಯ → of Bharadvāja
  • ಅಪತ್ಯಂ → offspring
  • ಭಾರದ್ವಾಜಃ → descendant of Bharadvāja

ಶೈಬ್ಯಃ ಚ ಶಿಬೇಃ ಅಪತ್ಯಂ

Śaibya means a descendant of Śibi.

  • ಶೈಬ್ಯಃ → descendant of Śibi
  • ಶಿಬೇಃ → of Śibi
  • ಅಪತ್ಯಂ → offspring

ಸತ್ಯಕಾಮಃ ನಾಮತಃ

Satyakāma is the personal name.

  • ಸತ್ಯಕಾಮಃ → Satyakāma
  • ನಾಮತಃ → by name

ಸೌರ್ಯಾಯಣೀ ಸೂರ್ಯಸ್ಯ ಅಪತ್ಯಂ

Sauryāyaṇi means a descendant of Sūrya.

  • ಸೌರ್ಯಾಯಣೀ → Sauryāyaṇi
  • ಸೂರ್ಯಸ್ಯ → of Sūrya
  • ಅಪತ್ಯಂ → offspring

ಛಾಂದಸಂ ಸೌರ್ಯಾಯಣೀತಿ

"Sauryāyaṇi" is the Vedic (metrical) form.

  • ಛಾಂದಸಂ → Vedic usage
  • ಸೌರ್ಯಾಯಣೀತಿ → the form "Sauryāyaṇi"

ಗಾರ್ಗ್ಯಃ ಗರ್ಗಗೋತ್ರೋತ್ಪನ್ನಃ

Gārgya is one born in the lineage of Garga.

  • ಗಾರ್ಗ್ಯಃ → Gārgya
  • ಗರ್ಗ → Garga
  • ಗೋತ್ರ → lineage
  • ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಃ → born

ಕೌಸಲ್ಯಃ ಚ ನಾಮತಃ

Kauśalya is the personal name.

  • ಕೌಸಲ್ಯಃ → Kauśalya
  • ನಾಮತಃ → by name

ಅಶ್ವಲಸ್ಯ ಅಪತ್ಯಂ ಆಶ್ವಲಾಯನಃ

Āśvalāyana means descendant of Aśvala.

  • ಅಶ್ವಲಸ್ಯ → of Aśvala
  • ಅಪತ್ಯಂ → offspring
  • ಆಶ್ವಲಾಯನಃ → descendant of Aśvala

ಭಾರ್ಗವಃ ಭೃಗೋಃ ಗೋತ್ರಾಪತ್ಯಂ

Bhārgava means one descended from Bhṛgu's lineage.

  • ಭಾರ್ಗವಃ → Bhārgava
  • ಭೃಗೋಃ → of Bhṛgu
  • ಗೋತ್ರಾಪತ್ಯಂ → descendant of the lineage

ವೈದರ್ಭಿಃ ವಿದರ್ಭೇಷು ಭವಃ

Vaidarbhi means belonging to Vidarbha.

  • ವೈದರ್ಭಿಃ → Vaidarbhi
  • ವಿದರ್ಭೇಷು → in Vidarbha
  • ಭವಃ → born/residing

ಕಬಂಧೀ ನಾಮತಃ

Kabandhi is the personal name.

  • ಕಬಂಧೀ → Kabandhi
  • ನಾಮತಃ → by name

ಕತ್ಯಸ್ಯ ಅಪತ್ಯಂ ಕಾತ್ಯಾಯನಃ

Kātyāyana means descendant of Katya.

  • ಕತ್ಯಸ್ಯ → of Katya
  • ಅಪತ್ಯಂ → offspring
  • ಕಾತ್ಯಾಯನಃ → descendant of Katya

ತೇ ಹ ಏತೇ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಪರಾಃ

These indeed were devoted to Brahman.

  • ತೇ → they
  • ಹ → indeed
  • ಏತೇ → these
  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಪರಾಃ → devoted to Brahman

ಅಪರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಪರತ್ವೇನ ಗತಾಃ

They had taken the lower Brahman as their immediate object of worship.

  • ಅಪರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ → lower Brahman (saguṇa Brahman)
  • ಪರತ್ವೇನ → as supreme
  • ಗತಾಃ → accepted

This is an important Śaṅkara gloss. Here "ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಪರಾಃ" is interpreted as seekers devoted to meditation upon saguṇa Brahman.

ತದನುಷ್ಠಾನನಿಷ್ಠಾಃ ಚ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿಷ್ಠಾಃ

And they were steadfast in its practice.

  • ತತ್ → that
  • ಅನುಷ್ಠಾನ → practice/worship
  • ನಿಷ್ಠಾಃ → steadfast
  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿಷ್ಠಾಃ → devoted to Brahman

ಪರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಅನ್ವೇಷಮಾಣಾಃ

Seeking the Supreme Brahman.

  • ಪರಂ → supreme
  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ → Brahman
  • ಅನ್ವೇಷಮಾಣಾಃ → searching for

Notice the distinction:

  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಪರಾಃ → devoted to lower Brahman
  • ಪರಂ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮ ಅನ್ವೇಷಮಾಣಾಃ → seeking knowledge of Nirguṇa Brahman

ಕಿಂ ತತ್ ಯತ್ ನಿತ್ಯಂ ವಿಜ್ಞೇಯಂ ಇತಿ

"What is that eternal Reality that ought to be known?"

  • ಕಿಂ ತತ್ → what is that?
  • ಯತ್ → which
  • ನಿತ್ಯಂ → eternal
  • ವಿಜ್ಞೇಯಂ → to be known
  • ಇತಿ → thus

Śaṅkara presents the inner enquiry motivating them.

ತತ್ಪ್ರಾಪ್ತ್ಯರ್ಥಂ ಯಥಾಕಾಮಂ ಯತಿಷ್ಯಾಮಃ

"We shall strive in every way to attain That."

  • ತತ್ → that
  • ಪ್ರಾಪ್ತಿ → attainment
  • ಅರ್ಥಂ → for the sake of
  • ಯಥಾಕಾಮಂ → by every possible effort
  • ಯತಿಷ್ಯಾಮಃ → we shall strive

ಏಷ ಹ ವೈ ತತ್ ಸರ್ವಂ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯತಿ ಇತಿ

"Surely he will explain all this."

  • ಏಷಃ → this teacher
  • ಹ ವೈ → indeed
  • ತತ್ ಸರ್ವಂ → all that
  • ವಕ್ಷ್ಯತಿ → will explain

ಆಚಾರ್ಯಂ ಉಪಜಗ್ಮುಃ

They approached the teacher.

  • ಆಚಾರ್ಯಂ → teacher
  • ಉಪಜಗ್ಮುಃ → approached

ಸಮಿತ್ಪಾಣಯಃ

Carrying fuel sticks in their hands.

  • ಸಮಿತ್ → sacrificial fuel
  • ಪಾಣಯಃ → in their hands

This signifies: humility discipleship readiness for service

ಸಮಿದ್ಭಾರಗೃಹೀತಹಸ್ತಾಃ ಸಂತಃ

Having their hands occupied with bundles of fuel.

  • ಸಮಿದ್ಭಾರ → bundle of fuel sticks
  • ಗೃಹೀತ → held
  • ಹಸ್ತಾಃ → hands
  • ಸಂತಃ → being

ಭಗವಂತಂ ಪೂಜಾವಂತಂ ಪಿಪ್ಪಲಾದಂ ಆಚಾರ್ಯಂ ಉಪಸನ್ನಾಃ

They approached the revered teacher Pippalāda.

  • ಭಗವಂತಂ → venerable one
  • ಪೂಜಾವಂತಂ → worthy of worship
  • ಪಿಪ್ಪಲಾದಂ → Pippalāda
  • ಆಚಾರ್ಯಂ → teacher
  • ಉಪಸನ್ನಾಃ → approached

docs.title: ಮಂತ್ರ 1.2
docs.text:
ತಾನ್ಹ ಸ ಋಷಿರುವಾಚ ಭೂಯ ಏವ ತಪಸಾ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯೇಣ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾ ಸಂವತ್ಸರಂ ಸಂವತ್ಸ್ಯಥ ಯಥಾಕಾಮಂ ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾನ್ಪೃಚ್ಛತ ಯದಿ ವಿಜ್ಞಾಸ್ಯಾಮಃ ಸರ್ವಂ ಹ ವೋ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮ ಇತಿ ॥ ೨ ॥ To them, the sage said: "Live here for one more year, practicing austerity, brahmacarya, and faith. Then ask questions according to your desire. If we know the answers, we shall explain everything to you."

ತಾನ್ ಹ — to them indeed

ತಾನ್ → to them ಹ → indeed

ಸ ಋಷಿಃ ಉವಾಚ — the sage said

ಸಃ → he ಋಷಿಃ → the sage ಉವಾಚ → said

ಭೂಯ ಏವ — for some more time; further

ಭೂಯಃ → further, additional ಏವ → indeed

ತಪಸಾ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯೇಣ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾ — through austerity, brahmacarya, and faith

ತಪಸಾ → through austerity ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯೇಣ → through brahmacarya ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾ → through faith

ಸಂವತ್ಸರಂ ಸಂವತ್ಸ್ಯಥ — you shall stay for a year

ಸಂವತ್ಸರಂ → for one year ಸಂವತ್ಸ್ಯಥ → you shall stay, dwell

ಯಥಾಕಾಮಂ ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾನ್ ಪೃಚ್ಛತ — ask questions according to your desire

ಯಥಾಕಾಮಂ → according to your wish ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾನ್ → questions ಪೃಚ್ಛತ → ask

ಯದಿ ವಿಜ್ಞಾಸ್ಯಾಮಃ — if we know

ಯದಿ → if ವಿಜ್ಞಾಸ್ಯಾಮಃ → we know

ಸರ್ವಂ ಹ ವಃ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮಃ — we shall indeed tell you everything

ಸರ್ವಂ → everything ಹ → indeed ವಃ → to you ವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮಃ → we shall tell

ಇತಿ — thus

ಇತಿ → thus

docs.title: ಭಾಷ್ಯ 1.1
docs.text:
ತಾನ್ ಏವಮುಪಗತಾನ್ ಸಃ ಹ ಕಿಲ ಋಷಿಃ ಉವಾಚ ಭೂಯಃ ಪುನರೇವ — ಯದ್ಯಪಿ ಯೂಯಂ ಪೂರ್ವಂ ತಪಸ್ವಿನ ಏವ, ತಥಾಪೀಹ ತಪಸಾ ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಸಂಯಮೇನ ವಿಶೇಷತೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯೇಣ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾ ಚ ಆಸ್ತಿಕ್ಯಬುದ್ಧ್ಯಾ ಆದರವಂತಃ ಸಂವತ್ಸರಂ ಕಾಲಂ ಸಂವತ್ಸ್ಯಥ ಸಮ್ಯಗ್ಗುರುಶುಶ್ರೂಷಾಪರಾಃ ಸಂತೋ ವತ್ಸ್ಯಥ । ತತಃ ಯಥಾಕಾಮಂ ಯೋ ಯಸ್ಯ ಕಾಮಸ್ತಮನತಿಕ್ರಮ್ಯ ಯದ್ವಿಷಯೇ ಯಸ್ಯ ಜಿಜ್ಞಾಸಾ ತದ್ವಿಷಯಾನ್ ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾನ್ ಪೃಚ್ಛತ । ಯದಿ ತದ್ಯುಷ್ಮತ್ಪೃಷ್ಟಂ ವಿಜ್ಞಾಸ್ಯಾಮಃ । ಅನುದ್ಧತತ್ವಪ್ರದರ್ಶನಾರ್ಥೋ ಯದಿ - ಶಬ್ದೋ ನಾಜ್ಞಾನಸಂಶಯಾರ್ಥಃ ಪ್ರಶ್ನನಿರ್ಣಯಾದವಸೀಯತೇ ಸರ್ವಂ ಹ ವೋ ವಃ ಪೃಷ್ಟಾರ್ಥಂ ವಕ್ಷ್ಯಾಮ ಇತಿ ॥ To those who had approached him in that manner, the sage indeed said again: "Although you are already practitioners of austerity, nevertheless, remain here for a year with discipline — practicing austerity in the form of control of the senses, especially brahmacarya, and faith, that is, a trusting attitude toward the authority of the scriptures and the teacher. Live here with reverence and with wholehearted dedication to serving the teacher. Thereafter, ask questions according to your respective desires. Whatever subject each of you wishes to know, and whatever inquiry arises in each one's mind, ask questions concerning that very subject. If we know the answer to what you ask, we shall explain it to you." The word 'if' (yadi) is used only to indicate the sage's humility and freedom from arrogance; it is not intended to imply ignorance or doubt. This is evident from the fact that all the questions are subsequently answered and resolved. Thus he says: "We shall indeed explain to you everything concerning the matters that you ask."

ತಾನ್ ಏವಮ್ ಉಪಗತಾನ್ ಸಃ ಹ ಕಿಲ ಋಷಿಃ ಉವಾಚ

The sage indeed said to those who had approached him in this manner.

  • ತಾನ್ → those (students)
  • ಏವಮ್ → thus, in this manner
  • ಉಪಗತಾನ್ → those who had approached
  • ಸಃ → he
  • ಹ ಕಿಲ → indeed
  • ಋಷಿಃ → the sage
  • ಉವಾಚ → said
  • ಭೂಯಃ ಪುನರೇವ

Further, once again.

  • ಭೂಯಃ → further, additionally
  • ಪುನಃ → again
  • ಏವ → indeed

ಯದ್ಯಪಿ ಯೂಯಂ ಪೂರ್ವಂ ತಪಸ್ವಿನ ಏವ

Although you are already practitioners of austerity,

  • ಯದ್ಯಪಿ → although
  • ಯೂಯಂ → you
  • ಪೂರ್ವಂ → previously, already
  • ತಪಸ್ವಿನಃ → practitioners of austerity
  • ಏವ → indeed

ತಥಾಪಿ ಇಹ ತಪಸಾ ಇಂದ್ರಿಯಸಂಯಮೇನ

Even so, here through tapas, namely control of the senses,

  • ತಥಾಪಿ → nevertheless
  • ಇಹ → here
  • ತಪಸಾ → through austerity
  • ಇಂದ್ರಿಯ-ಸಂಯಮೇನ → through restraint of the senses
  • ಇಂದ್ರಿಯ → senses
  • ಸಂಯಮ → control, restraint
  • ಏನ → by, through

Śaṅkara explicitly glosses tapas here as indriya-saṃyama (sense-control).

ವಿಶೇಷತೋ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯೇಣ

Especially through brahmacarya.

  • ವಿಶೇಷತಃ → especially, particularly
  • ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯೇಣ → through brahmacarya

ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾ ಚ ಆಸ್ತಿಕ್ಯಬುದ್ಧ್ಯಾ

And through faith, that is, a trusting attitude toward the scriptures and teacher.

  • ಶ್ರದ್ಧಯಾ → through faith
  • ಚ → and
  • ಆಸ್ತಿಕ್ಯ-ಬುದ್ಧ್ಯಾ → through an attitude of trust in the authority of the scriptures
  • ಆಸ್ತಿಕ್ಯ → faith in the validity of the Veda
  • ಬುದ್ಧಿ → understanding, attitude

ಆದರವಂತಃ ಸಂವತ್ಸರಂ ಕಾಲಂ ಸಂವತ್ಸ್ಯಥ

You shall live here for a year with reverence.

  • ಆದರ-ವಂತಃ → possessed of reverence
  • ಆದರ → respect, reverence
  • ವಂತಃ → possessing
  • ಸಂವತ್ಸರಂ ಕಾಲಂ → for the period of one year
  • ಸಂವತ್ಸ್ಯಥ → you shall stay

ಸಮ್ಯಕ್ ಗುರುಶುಶ್ರೂಷಾಪರಾಃ ಸಂತಃ ವತ್ಸ್ಯಥ

  • ಗುರು-ಶುಶ್ರೂಷಾ-ಪರಾಃ → devoted to service of the teacher

  • ಪರಾಃ → dedicated to
  • ಸಂತಃ → being
  • ವತ್ಸ್ಯಥ → you shall live

ತತಃ ಯಥಾಕಾಮಂ

Thereafter, according to your desire,

  • ತತಃ → then, thereafter
  • ಯಥಾ-ಕಾಮಂ → according to your wish
  • ಯಃ ಯಸ್ಯ ಕಾಮಃ ತಂ ಅನತಿಕ್ರಮ್ಯ

Without going beyond what each one desires to know.

  • ಯಃ → whichever
  • ಯಸ್ಯ → of whom
  • ಕಾಮಃ → desire
  • ತಂ → that
  • ಅನತಿಕ್ರಮ್ಯ → not transgressing, not exceeding

ಯದ್ವಿಷಯೇ ಯಸ್ಯ ಜಿಜ್ಞಾಸಾ

Regarding whatever subject each one has an inquiry,

  • ಯಸ್ಯ → of whom
  • ಜಿಜ್ಞಾಸಾ → desire to know, inquiry

  • ಪ್ರಶ್ನಾನ್ → questions
  • ಪೃಚ್ಛತ → ask

If we know that which is asked by you,

  • ತತ್ → that
  • ಯುಷ್ಮತ್-ಪೃಷ್ಟಂ → asked by you
  • ಯುಷ್ಮತ್ → by you
  • ಪೃಷ್ಟಂ → asked

The word "if" is used to indicate absence of arrogance.

  • ಅನುದ್ಧತತ್ವ-ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನಾರ್ಥಃ → for demonstrating humility
  • ಅನುದ್ಧತತ್ವ → non-arrogance, humility
  • ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನ → showing
  • ಅರ್ಥಃ → purpose
  • ಯದಿ-ಶಬ್ದಃ → the word "if"

This is an important observation of Śaṅkara.

ನ ಅಜ್ಞಾನಸಂಶಯಾರ್ಥಃ

It is not intended to suggest ignorance or doubt.

  • ಅಜ್ಞಾನ → ignorance
  • ಸಂಶಯ → doubt

This is understood from the subsequent resolution of the questions.

  • ಪ್ರಶ್ನ → questions
  • ನಿರ್ಣಯ → ascertainment, resolution
  • ಅವಸೀಯತೇ → is understood, is concluded
